title: Daily Activities and Habits — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Kebiasaan Toni mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: Toni eats candy in bed and does not brush his teeth.

choices.say: Toni eats candy in bed and does not brush his teeth.

visual.text: Toni brushes his teeth at night.

choices.say: Toni brushes his teeth at night.

visual.text: Toni washes his hands before dinner.

choices.say: Toni washes his hands before dinner.

items.reteach: Makan permen di tempat tidur tanpa gosok gigi membuat gigi rusak.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Sari's morning is in the correct order?

visual.text: Sari wakes up, takes a bath, and then goes to school.

choices.say: Sari wakes up, takes a bath, and then goes to school.

visual.text: Sari goes to school, then wakes up.

choices.say: Sari goes to school, then wakes up.

visual.text: Sari takes a bath before she wakes up.

choices.say: Sari takes a bath before she wakes up.

visual.text: Sari goes to school, then takes a bath at home.

choices.say: Sari goes to school, then takes a bath at home.

items.reteach: Bangun dulu, lalu mandi, lalu berangkat sekolah.

items.prompt: "I brush my teeth before I wake up." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kita menggosok gigi sesudah bangun: after I wake up.

items.prompt: "I go to bed in nine o'clock." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Untuk jam dipakai at: at nine o'clock.

items.prompt: Which of Dina's habits is good?

visual.text: Dina puts her shoes on the rack.

choices.say: Dina puts her shoes on the rack.

visual.text: Dina throws her bag on the floor.

choices.say: Dina throws her bag on the floor.

visual.text: Dina sleeps with the TV on.

choices.say: Dina sleeps with the TV on.

items.reteach: Menaruh sepatu di raknya adalah kebiasaan rapi.

items.prompt: "She take a bath every morning." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: She + kata kerja -s: She takes a bath.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Rudi's day is correct?

visual.text: Rudi has breakfast in the morning.

choices.say: Rudi has breakfast in the morning.

visual.text: Rudi has dinner in the morning.

choices.say: Rudi has dinner in the morning.

items.reteach: Breakfast pagi, lunch siang, dinner malam.

items.prompt: "On Sunday I wake up on seven o'clock." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: On untuk hari (on Sunday), at untuk jam (at seven o'clock).

items.prompt: Which habit before bed is not good?

visual.text: playing games on a phone until midnight

choices.say: playing games on a phone until midnight

items.reteach: Bermain ponsel sampai tengah malam membuat kurang tidur.

items.prompt: "We always washes our hands before we eat." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: We + kata kerja tanpa -s: We always wash our hands.

items.prompt: Which sentence about healthy habits is correct?

visual.text: We should drink enough water every day.

choices.say: We should drink enough water every day.

visual.text: We should eat candy every hour.

choices.say: We should eat candy every hour.

visual.text: We should sleep only two hours.

choices.say: We should sleep only two hours.

visual.text: We should never take a bath.

choices.say: We should never take a bath.

items.reteach: Minum air yang cukup setiap hari adalah kebiasaan sehat.

items.prompt: "I do my homework at the evening." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kita bilang in the evening.

items.prompt: What does Rudi do at 7 a.m. on Sunday?
items.reteach: Baris 7 a.m.: ride a bike.

items.prompt: When does Rudi take a nap on Sunday?
items.reteach: Take a nap ada di baris 1 p.m.

items.prompt: What does Rudi do right after he wakes up on Sunday?
items.reteach: Sesudah wake up (6 a.m.) adalah ride a bike (7 a.m.).

items.prompt: What does Wulan do first every morning?

stimulus.text: Every morning, Wulan feeds her chickens. Then she walks to school with her brother. In the afternoon, she helps her grandma in the shop.

items.reteach: Kalimat pertama: Every morning, Wulan feeds her chickens. Then … artinya sesudah itu.

items.prompt: How does Wulan go to school?

stimulus.text: Every morning, Wulan feeds her chickens. Then she walks to school with her brother. In the afternoon, she helps her grandma in the shop.

items.reteach: She walks to school = berjalan kaki = on foot.

items.prompt: Who does Wulan help in the afternoon?

stimulus.text: Every morning, Wulan feeds her chickens. Then she walks to school with her brother. In the afternoon, she helps her grandma in the shop.

items.reteach: In the afternoon, she helps her grandma in the shop.

items.prompt: How often does Lina read books?

stimulus.caption: How often do we do it?

items.reteach: Baris read books, kolom Lina: every day.

items.prompt: Who never watches TV?

stimulus.caption: How often do we do it?

items.reteach: Baris watch TV: Lina never, Joni sometimes.

items.prompt: Which activity does Joni do every day?

stimulus.caption: How often do we do it?

items.reteach: Kolom Joni: ride a bike = every day.

items.prompt: When must Class 2 students come to school?

stimulus.text: CLASS 2 RULES. Come to school before 7 a.m. Wash your hands before you eat. Put your rubbish in the bin.

items.reteach: Aturan pertama: Come to school before 7 a.m.

items.prompt: What must Class 2 students do before they eat?

stimulus.text: CLASS 2 RULES. Come to school before 7 a.m. Wash your hands before you eat. Put your rubbish in the bin.

items.reteach: Wash your hands before you eat.

items.prompt: Where do Class 2 students put their rubbish?

stimulus.text: CLASS 2 RULES. Come to school before 7 a.m. Wash your hands before you eat. Put your rubbish in the bin.

items.reteach: Put your rubbish in the bin. Bin = tempat sampah.

items.prompt: It is nine o'clock at night. Mother says, "It is late, Bimo." Bimo should …
items.reteach: Sudah malam, waktunya tidur.

items.prompt: Ani's hands are dirty, and lunch is ready. Ani should …
items.reteach: Cuci tangan dulu sebelum makan.

items.prompt: Dad: "What time do you go to school?" Nina: "I go to school ___ half past six."
items.reteach: Untuk jam dipakai at: at half past six.

items.prompt: Rafi's room is messy. Mom: "Please ___ your room before you play."
items.reteach: Tidy your room = rapikan kamarmu.

items.prompt: Teacher: "How do you come to school, Dimas?" Dimas: "I come ___ bike."
items.reteach: Naik kendaraan: by bike, by bus, by car.

items.prompt: Lulu is very sleepy in class because she watches TV until midnight. What should Lulu do?
items.reteach: Supaya tidak mengantuk, Lulu sebaiknya tidur lebih awal.

items.prompt: Grandma: "Dinner is ready! Please ___ the table." Toni puts the plates and spoons on the table.
items.reteach: Set the table = menata meja makan.

items.prompt: Sinta: "I don't go to school today. It is the ___."
items.reteach: Hari libur sekolah adalah weekend (Sabtu dan Minggu).

items.prompt: Mother: "It is very hot today. Drink a lot of ___."
items.reteach: Saat panas, minum banyak air: water.

items.prompt: Doni: "I always feel hungry at school." Teacher: "Do you eat breakfast?" Doni: "No, I ___ eat breakfast."
items.reteach: Doni selalu lapar karena tidak pernah sarapan: never.

items.prompt: Rina: "What do you do after school?" Tiko: "I ___ my homework first, then I play."
items.reteach: Kita bilang do my homework.

items.prompt: After playing football, Bayu is sweaty and dirty. He should …
items.reteach: Badan berkeringat dan kotor, jadi mandi: take a bath.

items.prompt: Put in order: (1) eat breakfast (2) take a bath (3) wake up (4) go to school
items.reteach: Wake up, take a bath, eat breakfast, lalu go to school.

items.prompt: Put in order: (1) rinse my mouth (2) brush my teeth (3) put toothpaste on the brush
items.reteach: Taruh pasta gigi, gosok gigi, lalu kumur: rinse my mouth.

items.prompt: Put in order: (1) pour the hot water into the cup (2) boil the water (3) drink the tea
items.reteach: Rebus air dulu, tuang ke cangkir, lalu minum tehnya.

items.prompt: Put the meals in order from morning to night: dinner, breakfast, lunch.
items.reteach: Breakfast pagi, lunch siang, dinner malam.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: five / I / at / up / wake / every / morning

visual.text: I wake up at five every morning.

choices.say: I wake up at five every morning.

visual.text: I wake at up five every morning.

choices.say: I wake at up five every morning.

visual.text: I up wake at five every morning.

choices.say: I up wake at five every morning.

visual.text: Wake I up at five every morning.

choices.say: Wake I up at five every morning.

items.reteach: Pola: I + wake up + at five + every morning.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: teeth / brush / my / I / twice / day / a

visual.text: I brush my teeth twice a day.

choices.say: I brush my teeth twice a day.

visual.text: I brush teeth my twice a day.

choices.say: I brush teeth my twice a day.

visual.text: I twice a day my brush teeth.

choices.say: I twice a day my brush teeth.

visual.text: My I brush teeth twice a day.

choices.say: My I brush teeth twice a day.

items.reteach: Pola: I + brush + my teeth + twice a day.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: the / sweep / I / floor / every / afternoon

visual.text: I sweep the floor every afternoon.

choices.say: I sweep the floor every afternoon.

visual.text: I the floor sweep every afternoon.

choices.say: I the floor sweep every afternoon.

visual.text: Sweep I the floor every afternoon.

choices.say: Sweep I the floor every afternoon.

visual.text: I sweep every the floor afternoon.

choices.say: I sweep every the floor afternoon.

items.reteach: Pola: I + sweep + the floor + every afternoon.

items.prompt: Put in order: (1) put the seed in (2) dig a hole (3) water it (4) cover it with soil
items.reteach: Gali lubang, masukkan biji, tutup dengan tanah, lalu siram.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: school / to / walks / Dina / every / day

visual.text: Dina walks to school every day.

choices.say: Dina walks to school every day.

visual.text: Dina to school walks every day.

choices.say: Dina to school walks every day.

visual.text: Walks Dina to school every day.

choices.say: Walks Dina to school every day.

visual.text: Dina walks every to school day.

choices.say: Dina walks every to school day.

items.reteach: Pola: Dina + walks + to school + every day.

items.prompt: Put in order: (1) dry my hands (2) wash my hands with soap (3) wet my hands
items.reteach: Basahi tangan, cuci dengan sabun, lalu keringkan.

items.prompt: Put in order: (1) get dressed (2) take a bath (3) put on my shoes
items.reteach: Mandi, berpakaian, lalu memakai sepatu.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: helps / Bima / his / father / always
items.reteach: Kata always diletakkan sebelum kata kerja: always helps.

items.prompt: Sari wakes up at five o'clock. She takes a bath thirty minutes later. When does she take a bath?
items.reteach: Thirty minutes = setengah jam. 5.00 + 30 menit = half past five.

items.prompt: Odd one out: breakfast, lunch, dinner, bedroom
items.reteach: Breakfast, lunch, dinner adalah waktu makan. Bedroom adalah kamar tidur.

items.prompt: Riddle: You use me with toothpaste every morning and night. What am I?
items.reteach: Toothpaste dipakai dengan toothbrush.

items.prompt: Riddle: My name has "break" and "fast" in it. You eat me in the morning. What am I?
items.reteach: Break + fast = breakfast, makan pagi.

items.prompt: Dodi goes to school on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. How many school days does he have in a week?
items.reteach: Hitung harinya: Monday sampai Friday = 5 hari.

items.prompt: Toothbrush is to teeth as comb is to …
items.reteach: Sikat gigi untuk gigi, sisir untuk rambut: hair.

items.prompt: Ana sleeps at nine at night and wakes up at five in the morning. How many hours does she sleep?
items.reteach: Jam 9 malam sampai jam 5 pagi = 8 jam = eight.

items.prompt: Odd one out: sweep, mop, wash, sleep
items.reteach: Sweep, mop, wash adalah pekerjaan membersihkan. Sleep artinya tidur.

items.prompt: Rina reads before she sleeps. She eats dinner before she reads. What does Rina do first?
items.reteach: Urutannya: eats dinner, reads, lalu sleeps.

items.prompt: Riddle: I come after Friday and before Sunday. Many children don't go to school on me. What am I?
items.reteach: Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

items.prompt: Letter code: A = 1, B = 2 … E = 5 … T = 20. Which activity is 5-1-20?
items.reteach: 5 = E, 1 = A, 20 = T. Jadi EAT.

items.prompt: Bobi brushes his teeth twice a day. How many times does he brush his teeth in three days?
